title: AnyEdit: Mastering Unified High-Quality Image Editing for Any Idea

layout.note: Left half (a): five stacked tinted bands of shrinking width, each a row of type cards; right half (b): a large sunburst tucked into the space freed under the two wide bands; captions for both halves along the bottom.

lesson: Give each category of a taxonomy one pastel colour and use it twice: for a tinted band of example cards (instruction plus before and after pair) and for the matching wedges of a sunburst, so examples and statistics read as one picture.
